units.path_and_authority: PE bytes -> target/actions -> DT/host preflight -> machine construction -> writes -> vCPU run -> reset replay/poweroff. Public library parser and CLI paths both included.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: CLI and JSON -> explicit device bus/slot/endpoint/backend choices -> fixed-first allocation. Inputs are requests, not admission authority.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Base and overlay -> drain/survey -> typed platform/resource plan -> backend consumers. Structural, informational, duplicate and unhandled entries considered separately from hardware realization.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Machine family/CPU/Memory/worker interface -> concrete VM. Includes CPU profiles, associated services, run/reset/error results.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Linux x86/Arm VM creation, memory, CPUID/register state, irqchip/GIC, IRQ/MSI/ioeventfd, MMIO attachment and thread execution. Direct/generic attachment and backend implicit effects included.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: macOS Arm VM, RAM and vCPU state, GIC and MMIO/interrupt services, generic attachment and thread execution. Native nondefault GIC extents remain a verification gap.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Windows x86 partition/RAM/vCPU, emulated IOAPIC and MSI, generic attachment and thread execution. Native negative/resource-isolation cases remain a verification gap.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: MMIO windows/interrupts/notifications/execution and shared-memory capability objects; syscon declared extent/value -> structured power/reset result. Borrow creation, forwarding and privacy transition inspected.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: DT window/reg-shift/interrupt -> shared ns16550 -> attached interrupt and host writer. Alternate constructor/set_interrupt path lacks instance admission. Output shares host-service boundary obligations.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: MMIO registers -> guest feature/queue configuration -> activation -> memory/notifier/interrupt and worker services -> reset. Public attachment setters included.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: BDF/ECAM/config/BAR/MSI-X -> nested component routing and interrupt delivery. BAR mutation, child translation and parent attachment included.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: PCI virtio capabilities/common config/queue enables/MSI-X -> device activation and reset. Shares device protocols with MMIO.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Guest queue/descriptors -> shared-memory reads/writes -> protocol worker/kicks -> used ring/interrupt; malicious traversal, mutable metadata, activation and stop/join paths.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Configured ports/stdio/inherited endpoints and resize listener -> data/control queues. Includes stdout thread/channel, global stdin producer, lifetime watcher, named-port RX, control pending replies, EOF, stop/reset and flush.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Virtio frames -> user stack or explicit bridge/macvtap; user TCP/UDP/DNS/DHCP/IPv6/forwarding and resolver workers; host sockets/fds, queue budgets, idle expiry and teardown included.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Storage owns backing contracts and QCOW adapter; raw-file implementation remains in block. Explicit authorized backing -> bounded storage operations. Portable I/O stays in backing modules; native authority/transfer and lifetime must conform to Machine services.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Guest chains -> locally bounded chain count -> copied request header -> checked stream/sector/backing bounds -> host I/O -> used publication. Shared index validation, outer-drain progress, publication errors and reset remain gaps. MAX_TRANSFER and block chain count already exist.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Configured backing resources -> synthetic GPT BlockBacking -> shared block protocol. Existing name/dependency violates adopted storage-gpt role. Portable file I/O is permitted; native authority and worker transfer/lifetime remain required.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Guest FUSE chains -> decode/dispatch -> host file/inode/handle tables -> reply. Path confinement, short/failing reads, malformed WRITE, xattr growth, bulk counts and teardown inspected.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

units.path_and_authority: Guest packets -> connection state machine -> Unix socket backend; blocking connect/write and connection authority/bounds under guest control.
units.limitations: Source-path accounting and scoped findings, not per-line security certification. Native unknowns retain issue owners. Prior code is unchanged; old policy interpretations are superseded.

limits: 154 tracked paths and 20 production units accounted for with scoped source review. Native unknowns retain issue owners; this is not per-line security or implementation-conformance certification.
